title: 中東情勢に左右される為替相場　専門家「また円安進む恐れも」
extracted_text: 政府・日銀が、円安食い止めのため2024年7月以来となる円買い・ドル売り介入に踏み切った。だが、中東情勢の混乱を受けた原油高や日米金利差などを背景とした円売り圧力は「構造的」な問題となっている。電撃介入はひとまず成果をあげたものの、市場では「効果は一時的で、再び円安の流れに戻る」との見方が多い。 為替介入は、ゴールデンウイークの連休中など為替市場の取引が薄い時期のほうが効果は出やすい。政府・日銀がこの先、断続的に介入を続けられれば、1ドル＝140円台まで円高が進む可能性もあるだろう。 また、（事前に示唆せずに）サプライズで介入した方が効果が大きくなることもあるが、この手法は何回も使えない。今回財務官が「退避勧告」との発言と、（介入という）「実弾」を組み合わせた。今後実弾がなくても再び発言するだけで効果が出るかもしれない。
translated_text: The government and the Bank of Japan have proceeded with yen-buying, dollar-selling intervention since July 2024 to curb yen depreciation. However, the yen-selling pressure driven by surging oil prices due to the Middle East chaos and the Japan-U.S. interest rate gap has become a 'structural' problem. The surprise intervention has achieved results for the time being, but the prevailing market view is that 'the effect is temporary and the yen depreciation trend will return.' Foreign exchange interventions tend to be more effective when trading volume in the currency market is low, such as during the Golden Week holiday period. If the government and BOJ can continue intermittent interventions, it is possible that the yen could appreciate to the 140-yen-per-dollar range. Moreover, surprise interventions without prior warning can sometimes have a greater effect, but this approach cannot be used repeatedly. The finance ministry official this time combined a 'withdrawal recommendation' statement with 'actual intervention.' In the future, the statement alone may be effective even without actual intervention.
title_en: Exchange Rates Driven by Middle East Situation; Experts Warn of Further Yen Depreciation
